npc_elder_01.speaker: npc
npc_elder_01.text: Oh, you're finally here, young one.

npc_elder_01.speaker: player
npc_elder_01.text: Hello. I'm looking for a way out of this forest.

npc_elder_01.speaker: npc
npc_elder_01.text: That path is dangerous. Prepare yourself first.

npc_elder_01.speaker: npc
npc_elder_01.text: Here, take a look at what I have. It isn't free, mind you.
